before: Table property commands had no tracked form; suggesting mode applied them directly.
after: setTableProperties, setTableColumnWidths, setTableRightEdgeWidth, setTableRowHeight, setTableCellBorders, setTableCellFill, and setTableCellVerticalAlignment accept optional revision attribution. They write tblPrChange, trPrChange, tcPrChange, and tblGridChange records that existing review decisions resolve. Created mark-family holders emptied by a restored record are removed.
reason: The optional local operation field lowers to the untracked command's primitive edits plus one table replacement holding the records. Peers receive canonical primitive edits only; no shared journal, schema, or transport field changes. Suggesting mode still applies unattributed property commands directly.
